company.shortDescription: Rival is a technology company building a platform for live events.
company.description: Rival is building the platform for the most coveted live events on the planet. They are a technology company powered by an exceptional team of engineers, product managers, and designers, bringing DNA from a broad swath of industries to solve decades-old problems with next generation technologies. They create amazing consumer and enterprise experiences for teams, venues, artists, and fans. Backed by world class venture capital, sports teams, venue owners across the globe, and leaders from the tech industry’s highest profile companies, their mission is to inspire the fan in everyone.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $25,000,000, or 75.76% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $30,182,389 to $118,412,134, a 3.92x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 13 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 40 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
